title: GPU Advanced Operations

tasks.description: Transpose shader - implement GPU transpose with shared memory optimization
LU decomposition shader - implement GPU-accelerated LU factorization
Batch operations - implement BatchExecutor for queueing multiple GPU operations
Async pipeline - implement async command buffer submission and result retrieval
GPU ↔ CPU sync strategy - implement efficient data synchronization patterns
Integration tests - test batch operations, async pipeline, and sync strategies

successCriteria: GPU transpose is faster than CPU for large matrices
GPU LU decomposition produces correct factors
Batch operations reduce GPU command overhead
Async pipeline allows overlap of CPU and GPU work
Sync strategy minimizes data transfer latency
notes: Sprint 15 adds advanced GPU operations and optimization infrastructure. Batch execution and async pipelines are critical for hiding GPU latency.
